executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check of 2026-09-02 reviewed eight relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure but will reach the market with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
